text:
sam: Heads-up — planning to bump release to v1.12.0 today, aiming for ship-window at 17:00PT. Need branch lock, changelog scrub, QA owners, and security sign-off. Will do cutoff at 16:30PT. Ping owners below.

anya: ack. I'll take docs sweep and changelog scrub. I'll push PR to update release notes.

miguel: taking QA ownership for e2e and smoke. I'll run canary tests early. @qa-bot can you start the smoke queue at 15:45PT?

qa-bot: scheduled smoke tests at 1956789400, will post results in this thread.

rachel: security can do a quick review. @security-bot please run dependency scan and SAST.

security-bot: dependency scan started — results ETA 20m. SAST queued.

kevin: branching question — should we lock main or create release/v1.12.0 and freeze merges to main? I prefer a release branch for hotfixes.

sam: create release/v1.12.0 and add branch protection (no direct pushes). I'll open the branch and tag.

liz: I'll bump the package versions and open the changelog PR. Small note: remember to update the telemetry opt-in docs.

sam: command for the bump:
```
./scripts/bump_version.sh 1.12.0
git push origin release/v1.12.0
```
Please don't merge other PRs into main after 16:30PT.

anya: posted changelog diff: internal_link/changelog-1.12.0. Small nit: reword "perf tweaks" to "runtime perf improvements".

miguel: QA checklist incoming:
- smoke (15:45)
- canary (16:00)
- load sanity (16:20)
I'll add results as comments.

rachel: security quick checklist:
- deps scan
- secrets scan
- runtime permissions review
I'll sign off once scans are clean.

deploy-bot: deploy window reserved 17:00PT -> 17:30PT. Please confirm all signoffs before 16:45PT to allow rollback prep.

kevin: code review ping — I'm holding two open PRs that need one more review. @anya can you glance at #4521 and #4523?

anya: on it. I'll finish reviews by 15:30.

sam: thanks. If all green, I'll cut the release tag at 16:35 and hand off to oncall for the push.

miguel: smoke passed ✅ (logs attached). Canary started.

rachel: deps scan clean, SAST flagged one low severity lint import — will not block. Security sign-off pending runtime permission check but looks good.

anya: changelog updated and docs PR linked: internal_link/docs-release-1.12.0. Ready to merge into release branch after version bump.

sam: final check: owners please reply with "sg" (ship go) if OK.

miguel: sg

anya: sg

rachel: sg (conditional on runtime permission doc note, filed as ticket #789)

kevin: sg

liz: sg

sam: ok locking branch now and tagging. I'll post release notes once tag is live. :shipit:
